standard_prerequisites.name: The locus where a relative cycle has nonzero fibre over a smooth morphism is open; more precisely the support behaviour of cycles along a smooth morphism of relative dimension (relative-cycles chapter, Lemma lemma-relative-cycle-smooth, canonical tag 0H5B)
standard_prerequisites.use: With openness of Y to S, yields the open neighbourhood of s disjoint from the equal locus.

core_obligations: Localize on S and pass to an affine cover so E is an intersection of the E_i (proof lines 1313-1319); for quasi-compact X and S set gamma = alpha - beta and use lemma-family-associated-closed-specialization (tag 0H57) to cover S by proper morphisms putting gamma into the image of equation-cycle-classes (tag 0H58), with E the union of the preimages, reducing to the image case (proof lines 1321-1331); squeeze gamma onto the scheme-theoretic union X' of the flat supporting subschemes, where gamma = i_* gamma' and the equal loci coincide (proof lines 1333-1342); finally for X of relative dimension at most r over S, at s outside E isolate a single component Z of the fibre with nonzero coefficient, apply more-morphisms-lemma-local-structure-finite-type (tag 052E) for the diagram X' over Y over S, observe the nonzero coefficient survives flat pullback g^* and pushforward pi_* (so s stays outside the equal loci of gamma' and gamma''), and conclude with lemma-relative-cycle-smooth (tag 0H5B) and openness of Y to S that a neighbourhood of s misses E, proving E closed (proof lines 1344-1380).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to X and S quasi-compact by locality on S and affine covers (proof lines 1313-1319).
Replace the difference by an image cycle over a proper cover using the named specialization lemma (proof lines 1321-1331).
Squeeze onto the union of the supporting flat subschemes (proof lines 1333-1342).

At a point outside E isolate a component, transport the nonzero coefficient through the local-structure diagram, and conclude openness of the complement by the smoothness lemma (proof lines 1344-1380).
